fields.statement: What shape does .rhiza/dispatch.toml take? There are two triggers (request queued, change set ready) and three request kinds (feature, bug, milestone). / How are bad workflow names handled: a rule in .rhiza/dispatch.toml, or a `rhiza request --workflow` value, naming a workflow no layer (personal, repo or built-in) resolves? / Which kind does a change set get when no request opened it, e.g. one opened by a milestone plan or by `rhiza change new`? The ready trigger maps kind to workflow. / Where does the owner see what dispatch picked?
